title: SourceStateResolution
description: The result of executing owner_ρ(evidenceUnitId): the source state a profile version resolved an evidence unit to, together with the profile version that resolved it. This is a COMPUTED RESULT and follows the provenance rule of spec/09.4, whereas the SourceStateRef it wraps stays a versionless declarative reference — ⟨profileId, sourceStateId⟩ identifies the same source state across versions of a profile. The two are kept apart deliberately: `profileVersion` versions grounding BEHAVIOR, so two versions of one profile may legitimately resolve the same evidence unit to different source states, and a payload stored on its own would otherwise not say which version produced it. Only the grounding profile is named here: owner resolution never depends on an admission policy. INVARIANT: `sourceState.profileId` MUST equal the enclosing `profileId` — one resolution names one profile, and a mismatch is non-conformant. JSON Schema cannot express equality between two fields, so this is a normative rule enforced by implementations and their conformance tests, not by this document.

profileId.description: The grounding profile that performed the resolution. MUST equal `sourceState.profileId`.

profileVersion.description: Exact version of that profile — the version pinned by the caller, or the one the deployment resolved when no pin was given.
